sound_intent.texture_bed: dark atmospheric layers with subtle movement
sound_intent.one_shot_hits: sharp, punchy samples emphasizing rhythmic hooks
sound_intent.overall: experimental West Coast Hip-Hop sound with hook-focus and dark mood

routing_intent.drums: send to punchy compressor chain emphasizing transient definition
routing_intent.bass: parallel saturation and EQ emphasizing low-mids
routing_intent.chords: reverb and delay for spatial depth
routing_intent.vocal: dry with slight distortion for grit

designer_intent.goal: Create a dark, experimental West Coast Hip-Hop arrangement emphasizing hook-driven energy and texture through sample manipulation.

presetor_intent.focus: Maintain clarity and punch in drums and hook sections while using experimental textures to enhance mood.

sensei_drum.brief: Generate drum patterns emphasizing hook sections using sample slicing and transient shaping for punch and variation.

bass_generator.brief: Create bass lines using looping and subtle variations to complement drums and maintain groove within dark mood.

harmony_generator.brief: Develop harmonic textures with sample-based chord slices that contribute atmosphere and complement bass and melody.

melody_generator.brief: Design sparse melodic motifs using spectral slicing to provide hook accents without overpowering texture.

ai_designer.brief: Manage experimental arrangement structure, ensuring energy distribution aligns with hook-heavy profile and dark mood.

presetor.brief: Apply effects and mixing presets that enhance transient clarity, texture depth, and overall mood consistency.

songgps.brief: Coordinate arrangement and energy curve to maximize hook impact while supporting experimental textural elements.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Balance and process unprocessed channel audio to maintain clarity, dynamics, and dark atmosphere throughout track.
